notes: Always use slim/bookworm-slim/alpine/distroless variants. Prefer distroless static for Go runtime stages. Never use :latest in production Dockerfiles. Tags are validated against the real fleet Dockerfiles; update both together when bumping a base image (see go-version.json / elixir-version.json for the canonical language versions). Entries with "kind": "runtime" are third-party images deployed by manifest/Helm, not Dockerfile bases: "approved_tags" is the tag that should run, "deployed" what runs (measured on "upstream_checked"), and "upstream_latest*" the newest release. ADR-158 M11: the weekly platform check compares the three.
